Haryana panchayat accounts in PNB faced a Rs 100-crore cyber fraud, leading to the arrest of eight individuals.

The fraud surfaced after Rs 74.7 lakh was transferred via seven unauthorized transactions to a private Noida bank account.

Source: The Indian Express

news.headline:
Telecanor Global reported Q2 sales of INR 62.2 million, up from INR 57.4 million a year ago.

The company announced earnings results for the second quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026.

Source: MarketScreener India
